curated_items.title: Codex CLI Release: 0.159.0
curated_items.summary: New Features Opt-in instant_interrupt lets new input steer Codex during model responses or long-running code-mode calls. ( #48135 , #48141 ) New sessions get a compact welcome screen and consistent headers, with occasional tips during and after turns. ( #48513 , #48562 , #48352 ) The warnings viewer dismisses reviewed warnings when closed; press k to keep one for later. ( #48205 , #48206 ) You can scroll the transcript while deciding whether to implement a plan. ( #48805 ) Native Mermaid rendering supports more flowchart edges, labels, and node groups. ( #48814 , #48895 ) App-server clients can paginate thread history from a specific item.
